media.title: Pokémon: The Johto Journeys, Ash's enthusiastic first partner Chikorita
media.note: Chikorita becomes an expressive, devoted member of Ash's team through the Johto arc.

community: Chikorita is remembered fondly as Ash's first Johto partner, and fans often bring up how openly affectionate it was toward him in the anime compared to his other starters.

why.text: Chikorita's battle fragrance calms things into what the Pokédex calls a cozy, friendly atmosphere for everyone involved.
It checks the temperature and humidity with the leaf on its head before it settles down to rest.
It became Ash's enthusiastic first Johto partner, greeting him with real excitement from the very start.
